title: Maximal filters in the lattice of closed convex sets: Lean 4 formalization
description: A Lean 4 formalization accompanying the paper Maximal filters in the lattice of closed convex sets. Maximal filters of the lattice of closed convex subsets of R^n are classified by an affine subspace A, a linear subspace W containing the direction space of A, and a vector space order on W in which that direction space is order-convex, subject to W = 0 when A is a point. The development comprises 28 files and 502 declarations; every declaration compiles and its axiom profile is {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}.
